summary: Completed backend+frontend verification for preview->live content release sync logic using isolated Mongo fixture DBs and real preview APIs. Backup-first import, rollback, restore safety backup, source/target identity gating, create-only auth seed behavior, and auto-capture of baked content_release.json after draft mutation all passed. Admin UI at /admin/transfer is correct and release panel actions work.

ui_bugs.issue: Regression note: live editor persisted open/close/navigate/reload, but live-editor logout control remained visible during authenticated public browsing (possible mismatch with requested 'hides logout' behavior).

integration_issues.issue: Observed repeated 401 console/network entries for /api/auth/me while unauthenticated (non-blocking, expected auth probe pattern).

action_items: Confirm expected product behavior for public live-editor logout control visibility; hide if required.
If required, add an explicit frontend assertion path/spec for logout hidden-state to prevent future regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: content_sync.target.apply correctly performs validation before write, backup before mutation, and full rollback on write failure.
Seed logic is create-only for owner bootstrap: existing users/password_hash/roles remained unchanged under different ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD values.
Runtime startup path applies baked() snapshot and does not depend on a moving latest pointer, aligning with cold-start safety requirement.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed tests passed (39 passed, 2 skipped across full suite; content-sync file 14/14 passed)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% targeted checks passed (admin transfer route/panel/prepare + live-editor persistence passed; logout-visibility mismatch noted)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data added to preview/production DBs. Temporary isolated fixture DBs were created and dropped during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run validated P0 sync behavior mostly via isolated DB method-level tests plus real preview API/UI smoke. content_release.json was re-captured cleanly at end using /app/backend/scripts/prepare_content_release.py (release_id e5d5ca14647f80681e73d484abb810c58d48c040d38d4d7822b8651e557bb98c). /admin/import-export correctly showed Not Found (wrong route test); /admin/transfer is the functional route with release panel showing 10 pages, 3 notes, 63 media, Rakhigarhi 9 sections.
rca of the issue: No backend sync RCA defects were reproduced in this run. The originally reported republish gap (Rakhigarhi placeholder after live apply) is not reproducible under current code path in isolated target simulations: validated source-authoritative import of pages/notes/media/settings, protection of users/enquiries/auth collections, idempotent no-op on identical release, forced apply backup creation, and rollback to exact pre-import content on injected mid-write failure. Remaining questionable behavior is frontend-level live-editor logout visibility expectation.
